_help.auto_lower_quality: true: lower the quality automatically until the ETA fits time_budget_s. false: keep your quality and only warn (red plan line). Toggle with B while selecting.
_help.centerline_resolution: Raster size for centerline mode (0 = auto).
_help.config_version: Internal: used to update old settings files. Do not edit.
_help.draw_key: Key held for the whole drawing (BAR action drawinmap). sc:0x29 = scan code of the key left of 1, which BAR's Grid and Legacy profiles bind (sc_`). Legacy 60%: sc:0x10 (Q). Grid 60%: sc:0x39+sc:0x10 (Space as meta + Q). Also vk:0xC0 or key names. It is pressed only once per drawing: pressing it twice within 750 ms opens BAR's label prompt.
_help.dry_run: Simulate drawing on the overlay without sending any input (for testing).
_help.edge_contrast: layered: minimum colour difference (0..1) for a boundary between two coloured areas to be drawn. Raise it (e.g. 0.15) to skip subtle shading edges, lower it for more detail.
_help.edge_warning_percent: Warn when the box is closer than this to a screen edge (edge scrolling would move the camera mid-drawing).
_help.fit: content: fit the visible drawing into the box; viewbox: fit the SVG canvas (keeps its margins).
_help.game_fps: Your in-game FPS. The game accepts one vertex per 50 ms checked once per frame, so the safe vertex interval is ~50 ms + 1.2 frames.
_help.game_window_title: If set, drawing only starts when the foreground window title contains this text.
_help.hud_scale: Size of the overlay text and panels (1 = default).
_help.layered_resolution: Raster size used to work out what is visible in layered mode (higher = more exact, slower).
_help.line_width_percent: layered: visible regions narrower than this percentage of the drawing size, and darker than their surroundings, are lines and drawn once along their middle.
_help.max_segment_px: Split long straight segments (0 = off). Map lines are straight in 3D between endpoint heights, so on hilly maps long segments can disappear into hills; ~60 helps.
_help.mode: auto | layered | outline | centerline. layered: colour art made of overlapping objects — only visible lines are drawn (nothing hidden behind other objects), outlines become single lines. centerline: one-colour line art (coloring pages, potrace output) as single lines. outline: the border of every filled shape (x-ray). auto picks layered for multi-colour or clipped art, otherwise centerline/outline.
_help.msaa: Anti-aliased overlay. Set false if the overlay is black instead of transparent (needs a restart).
_help.order: nearest (draws like a human, neighbouring strokes in sequence) | longest (main shapes first) | document.
_help.press_gap_ms: Minimum time between left presses (-1 = auto: 300 ms + 1.2 frames + 10 ms). Two presses within 300 ms open BAR's label prompt.
_help.preview_line_px: Line width of the in-game estimate (map lines are 3 px).
_help.quality: 1 (fast, rough) … 7 (slow, exact). Default 7: with auto_lower_quality the planner steps down only as far as the time budget requires. Ctrl+wheel / PageUp / PageDown while selecting.
_help.resume_hotkey: Continues an interrupted drawing at the same place.
_help.settle_ms: Pause between key/button events so the game processes them in order.
_help.skip_white_fills: Ignore white/near-white filled shapes without stroke (backgrounds, highlights).
_help.start_delay_ms: After Space, drawing waits until every key is released, then this long.
_help.startup_notification: Show a Windows notification when bardraw starts.
_help.stop_on_mouse_shake_px: 0 = mouse movement never stops drawing (real moves are blocked while drawing, so they cannot spoil it). Set e.g. 400 to stop by shaking the mouse: sustained movement counts, small bumps do not.
_help.svg_path: SVG file or folder of SVGs (relative to this file). Tab / Shift+Tab cycles files while selecting.
_help.time_budget_s: Drawing time limit in seconds (0 = none). BAR erases map marks ~60 s after they are drawn by default, so a longer drawing loses its start before it ends. The plan line turns red when the ETA exceeds it. Alt+wheel changes it in 10 s steps while selecting.
_help.tray_icon: Show the notification-area icon (menu: open drawings folder, edit settings, dry run, quit). Needs a restart.
_help.trigger_hotkey: Starts box selection. Modifiers: ctrl, shift, alt, win. Keys: a-z, 0-9, f1-f24, home, end, insert, delete, pageup, pagedown, …
_help.vertex_interval_ms: Override the time per vertex (0 = derive from game_fps). Too low = corners get skipped.
